appearance: Bright daytime with scattered clouds; some qualifying shots warmer/overcast.
layout: Circuit of the Americas 5.513km/20-corner Grand Prix layout.
sector_registration: All stations in retained native origin. Approximate full-route zones; individual decor must stay beyond verified protection and runoff.

sectors.name: Main straight, uphill T1 and T2
sectors.observed_environment: Long main-stand/pit complex, steep uphill blind T1 crest, spectator hill and low broadleaf trees. Wide asphalt/painted runoff and US flag geometry; opening hill must be real mesh relief.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: T3–T10 esses
sectors.observed_environment: Rolling linked esses through grassy banks and sparse broadleaf woodland. Spectators on crests, open horizon, red/white kerbs and red/white/blue geometric runoff only on actual outside aprons.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: T11 hairpin
sectors.observed_environment: Broad slow hairpin with large red/white apex treatment, outside paved escape, broad grass and low tree line; no close urban wall.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: Back straight to T12
sectors.observed_environment: Long cresting straight, wide grass verges, square timing/advertising structures and large braking-zone apron. Stand mass beyond T12; sparse low service buildings.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: T13–T15 stadium
sectors.observed_environment: Low bowl grandstands and broad coloured paved aprons. Red tubular observation-tower spine/curved cantilever crown rises beyond T16–18 and amphitheatre, not arbitrary roadside position.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: T16–T18 triple right
sectors.observed_environment: Distinctive broad red/white/blue runoff, low trees and temporary bleachers, steel advertising bridges. Tower and amphitheatre compound dominate infield skyline.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: T19, T20 and pit return
sectors.observed_environment: Wide final painted aprons, grass islands, multi-tier main-straight roof and long white pit bar; catch fences and viewing decks, distant observation wheel.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

terrain.shortcomings: GLO-90 relief21.933m does not validate T1crest or rolling esses. USGS3DEP TexasCentral LiDAR candidate noted historically but fine payload absent; do not fabricate survey. Tower official height251ft=76.5048m. Marketing133ft incline is not a geodetic road-height control.

terrain.racing_deck_correction: Separate independentlydigitized primary Formula1roadprofile now replaces contaminated/coarseGLO90 racingprofile. Landscapegrid remains separatelysourced. T1relativeclimb30.9m is independently stated in official article. Preserve rollingesses and backstraight crests by everycorner registration; no use of marketing133ft as surveyed roadheight.

authoring_constraints: Use mapped building footprints and match rooflines, structural supports, facade depth and stepped volumes; names alone do not establish likeness.
Place grass/gravel/asphalt runoff per registered corner, with protection at outside edge; do not fill escape areas with independent tiles/blocks.
Road, kerbs, shoulder and protection share smooth station sampling; kerbs only in explicit ranges.
Maintain venue-specific vegetation around complete route, preserving long sightlines/open water where present.
Reference pixels remain ignored; generate geometry and materials only.
quality_gates: Matching cockpit frame at each sector and every braking/turn sequence.
Oblique view of runoff shapes, architectural footprints and terrain.
Full lap motion review for edge smoothness, floating objects, protection gaps and missing surroundings.
Luna high reviewer must evaluate rendered evidence, not this recipe.

runoff_paint_review.height_policy: Ground-following polygon geometry, clipped outside road_mask. No fixed-z tiles and no enlargement of physical runoff corridors.
